mechanism: Compute per-trade risk exposure as rpo = glot * (spread + 1 + (StopLoss * tick_value)). If rpo exceeds max_risk_per_operation, scale lot down to floor((max_risk/rpo)*glot / volume_step)*volume_step; inverse GetSL isolates SL points from risk/lot. Free-margin OrderCalcMargin caps max lot.
data_needed: SYMBOL_SPREAD, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP, ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE, OrderCalcMargin, user max risk in account currency, SL in points.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD example (margin ~1326 USD/lot); also EURUSD 5-digit SL example; tick/point of _Symbol
why_new_for_mis: Turns live spread+tick_value+SL into an explicit monetary exposure sensor that gates size—MIS can stream risk-normalized position intensity rather than raw lot.

mechanism: Define MDL (24h), MWL (week), ML (lifetime), and max loss per trade. Periodically recompute accumulated losses/profits; on every tick compare against thresholds; on breach close all positions and suspend trading until next day/week (or enter recovery for ML).

mechanism: MODE_SUPERATE chooses how a loss/profit limit is observed: EQUITY (curr_profit floating only), CLOSE_POSITION (horizon closed PnL only), or CLOSE_POSITION_AND_EQUITY (adjust remaining allowance by closed PnL then compare floating). IsSuperated/MDP_IsSuperated implement the three observers for ML/MWL/MDL/MDP.
data_needed: curr_profit (open floating); daily/weekly/gross closed profit; configured limit values; positions_open flag.

quote: CLOSED_POSITION_AND_EQUITY: This is the most comprehensive and accurate method because it combines both approaches mentioned above. The function simultaneously assesses the profit or loss on positions closed during the day and the current real-time equity.
